jobs.title: Senior Director AI and Operations Engineering
jobs.description:
A career as Senior Director, AI and Operations Engineering in the Wealth Management Operations team at National Bank means acting as a leader in accelerating the transformation of wealth management operations by designing and deploying hyper-automation solutions that combine AI, automation, software development and agent technologies to simplify processes, increase operational capacity, improve the client experience and employé.es and sustainably reduce the cost of service.
You act as a field technology leader, able to identify high-value opportunities, select the right technology, rapidly prototype and industrialize secure, resilient and economically viable solutions. It is by relying on your experience in transformation, technology and with your knowledge of the investment sector and/or capital markets that you have a positive impact on the experience of our users, our employees, as well as on our ability to be a growth partner of choice for our organization.
Your job

Identify processes or automation, AI where agentic capabilities can drive the most value
Choose the simplest technology that effectively solves the problem rather than always applying the same technology
Remain concretely involved on the technical level and be able to quickly transform an operational issue into a functional solution
Accelerate process transformation, drive adoption of new solutions, and drive initiatives from idea to prototype, ensuring delivery of expected benefits
Ensure the economic viability of solutions: infrastructure, licenses, consumption, model costs and value generated
Building solutions where security, privacy, traceability and operational resilience are "Build by design"
Develop strong engineering expertise within operations to accelerate the adoption of automation and artificial intelligence in their ways of doing things
Generate business value through automation and optimization of operational capacity by ensuring the quality of solutions and controlling the risks associated with automation
Monitor the performance of solutions and measure the gains made

Your team

Within the Wealth Management Operations sector, you are part of a team of 650 colleagues and report to the Vice-President, Wealth Management Operations.
As a leader, you lead an engineering team of about 12 people, composed of two directors, developers and citizen developers, directly integrated into operations.
Our team stands out for our expertise, our understanding of our processes, our proximity to our business lines and our technology teams, our rigor, our ambition to be the best operational center and our "One team" culture. Being part of our team means being part of a winning team that succeeds in combining pleasure, ambition and results.
You benefit from a hybrid work model with a required presence in the office three days a week (minimum) and the option to work remotely the other two days, promoting both in-person collaboration and flexibility.
You will be required to travel occasionally between Montreal and Toronto in order to promote close collaboration with teams and partners.
We favor a variety of forms of continuous learning to enrich your development, including learning in action, training content made available to you and working in collaboration with colleagues with diverse expertise and profiles.
Prerequisites

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science or related technology field or any other combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
7 to 10 years of relevant experience in managing operational and technological teams, including management of managers.
Experience in the wealth management and/or capital markets industry.
Recognized experience in organizational transformation, process optimization and continuous improvement, particularly in the management of major changes involving operational, technological, human and risk management issues.
Strong knowledge of software development, Python, APIs, integration, and cloud architecture, as well as modern software engineering practices such as Git, CI/CD, testing, and monitoring.
Expertise in automation and artificial intelligence, including workflows, RPA, low-code/no-code solutions, generative AI, large language models (LLMs) and agentic technologies.
Good understanding of the economics of AI, including model consumption, inference costs, and trade-offs between performance and cost.
Good knowledge of the principles of cybersecurity, data protection and responsible AI, including access management, auditability and resilience.
Builder mentality, strong operational acumen and mobilizing leadership, with an ability to experiment quickly, simplify processes, collaborate with subject matter experts and evolve prototypes into secure, resilient and deployable solutions at scale.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Artificial Intelligence, Business Alignment, Communication, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, Emotional Intelligence, Innovation Management, Managerial Courage, Mobilization, Partner Development, Risk Management, Strategic Vision, Strategy Execution, Stress Management, Technical Leadership

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

jobs.title: Chief Technology & Strategy Officer
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Chief Technology & Strategy Officer (CTSO) participates in the development and execution of corporate strategy as part of Cascadia Credit Union’s (CCU) executive team in accordance with policies, goals, and objectives established by the CEO and the Board of Directors. Overseeing and Leading CCU's corporate planning, strategic initiatives, and technology functions, the CTSO works collaboratively across the organization to identify opportunities for growth, operational excellence, organizational effectiveness, and enhanced member value.

This position provides direction, communication, and leadership in strategic planning, organizational transformation, and enterprise-wide initiatives, ensuring organizational priorities are translated into measurable outcomes and supporting the overall and long-term business strategy of CCU. The CTSO facilitates the corporate planning process, guides the delivery of key strategic initiatives, and promotes innovation that strengthens CCU's sustainability and competitive position.

This position role model’s leadership, promoting and living CCU values, and fostering a culture where members are at the centre of our decision making, employees are knowledgeable, and CCU is recognized as a committed community partner.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

·        Fosters relationships through service excellence and knowledge to support staff and provide leadership in the development and execution of corporate strategy and organization priorities.
·        Collaborates with executive leadership to develop corporate strategies and policies; identifies and meets short and long-term objectives and areas of information systems and technology.
·        Leads the development, facilitation, and monitoring of CCU's corporate strategic planning process and associated business plans.
·        Oversees the successful delivery of enterprise-wide strategic initiatives and transformational projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
·        Develops frameworks and reporting mechanisms to measure progress against strategic objectives and key performance indicators.
·        Identifies emerging trends, opportunities, and risks that may impact CCU's long-term success and recommends strategic responses.
·        Promotes innovation, continuous improvement, and organizational effectiveness across the credit union.
·        Directs and leads the credit union's information systems, programming, cyber-security, and IT operations functions and seeks innovative strategies to ensure optimum integration of the enterprise technology framework.
·        Utilizes data and promote the use of data to support organization effectiveness and the delivery of proactive needs-based advice.
·        Manages key relationships to ensure compliance with any legislation, regulation, and/or suitable guidelines based on the size and complexity of the credit union.
·        Provides overall management and direction of information technology and related policies, procedures, and objectives.
·        Implements functional risk management tools and mechanisms to effectively secure and safe - guard the credit union’s IT infrastructure.                              
·        Supports employees' development through a demonstrated commitment to coaching and other development activities.
·        Builds and leads a high performing team to execute on strategies and to meet current needs and future demands.
·        Promotes CCU in the community through active participation in community events and professional associations.

Skills & Attributes

·        Demonstrates strong strategic thinking skills and the ability to translate vision into measurable organizational outcomes.
·        Demonstrated ability to lead strategic planning, organizational transformation, and enterprise-wide initiatives.
·        Demonstrated commitment to applying relevant and applicable policies and procedures in the day-to-day performance of the functions of this position.
·        Committed to personal growth and development; responsible for ensuring skills and knowledge are up to date to meet industry and position requirements.
·        Takes a proactive and respectful approach in addressing problems, issues, or conflict with a positive view to reaching new and better solutions.
·        Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and thoughtful, clear, and open communication.
·        Team player, driven to ensure that the whole team is successful in meeting organizational needs.
·        Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
·        Demonstrates strong attention to detail and accuracy in completing work and providing information.
·        Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
·        Exceptional time management & organizational skills.

Qualifications

·        Minimum four (4) years post-secondary education; diploma or degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Leadership, Strategy, Finance, Economics, or a related field preferred.
·        Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in management or leadership role.
·        Combined experience and post-secondary education in the areas that directly relate to the financial industry and IT will be considered.
·        Demonstrates relevant knowledge and understanding of the external credit union environment.
·        Demonstrate an exceptional understanding of information systems and technology.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology Enablement
jobs.description:
The Klick Group
—comprising Klick Health (including Klick Katalyst and btwelve), Klick Media Group, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), Klick Consulting, and Klick Ventures—is an ecosystem dedicated to realizing the full potential of our people and clients in life sciences. Founded in 1997, we have offices in New York, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, Toronto, London, São Paulo, and Singapore. Consistently named a Best Managed Company, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and Great Place to Work, Klick is committed to fostering a high-performance, people-first culture with creativity, collaboration, innovation, and impact across everything we do.

About Our Technology Craft

The Technology Craft powers Klick’s platforms, products, and delivery capabilities across healthcare and life sciences. Teams design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and compliant solutions across web, CRM, data, and marketing technologies. By partnering closely with Strategy, Creative, and Client Services, the Technology Craft enables integrated omnichannel experiences that deliver real business impact.

Job Description

The Vice President, Technology (Technology Enablement) is accountable for the successful delivery of Klick’s core omnichannel technology solutions across a portfolio of healthcare and life sciences clients. Reporting to the SVP of Technology, this role provides portfolio-level delivery leadership, ensures consistent execution across teams, and builds client confidence in complex, regulated environments. The VP leads through senior Technology Enablement Leads, balancing delivery excellence, operational rigor, and scalable practices as client needs and platforms evolve.

What You’ll Do

Lead delivery execution across a multi-client technology portfolio spanning web platforms, CRM systems, Veeva, and integrated marketing technologies.
Own end-to-end accountability for technology delivery outcomes across Klick-hosted and client-managed environments, ensuring adherence to SDLC, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Client Services, Omnichannel Enablement, Strategy, Creative, PMO, and Technology leaders to align delivery plans with business and omnichannel objectives.
Act as the escalation point for delivery risk, making informed trade-offs across scope, resourcing, timing, and quality to maintain predictability and client confidence.
Evolve Klick’s technology delivery operating model by improving governance, forecasting, KPIs, and delivery standards to support scalable, repeatable execution.

Qualifications

Required:

12+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise technology solutions, with accountability for large-scale, multi-stream delivery programs.
Demonstrated leadership overseeing omnichannel technology delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe Experience Manager, or comparable enterprise ecosystems.
Proven experience leading through senior delivery leaders and cross-functional teams, with clear ownership of outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Hands-on experience with delivery governance frameworks, including SDLC, portfolio planning, risk management, and delivery performance metrics.
Strong executive communication skills, including translating technical risk and delivery trade-offs for senior business, IT, and client stakeholders.

Desired:

Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
Experience delivering technology solutions within US pharmaceutical or healthcare environments, including exposure to regulatory and MLR considerations.
Agency or consulting background supporting enterprise clients across multiple accounts and delivery models.
Experience contributing to growth and solution shaping efforts by assessing feasibility, delivery risk, and execution readiness.
Demonstrated success building and scaling delivery leadership teams while fostering continuous improvement and operational maturity.

Additional Information

This posting is to backfill a role at Klick.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.

jobs.description:
Head of Digital Marketing – Vanguard Canada

The Head of Digital Marketing for Canada will shape and lead the digital strategy that connects investors and advisors to Vanguard's products, insights, and thought leadership. This leader will play a critical role in advancing Vanguard's mission to give clients the best chance for investment success by creating meaningful, data-driven digital experiences that drive engagement, acquisition, and retention.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience leading digital marketing organizations within the financial services industry, with a strong understanding of investor and advisor audiences, financial products, regulatory considerations, and the unique dynamics of the wealth and asset management landscape. They will combine strategic vision with hands-on digital marketing expertise to deliver measurable business outcomes and elevate Vanguard's digital capabilities.

Responsibilities:

Develop and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels to support Vanguard Canada's growth objectives.
Establish leading digital marketing practices, optimize performance across the customer journey, and improve return on investment for key business partners.
Build and maintain a best-in-class digital marketing ecosystem that supports personalized, connected experiences for both advisor and investor audiences.
Lead the evolution of content and digital engagement strategies, ensuring communications are timely, relevant, compliant, and personalized across all channels.
Manage the paid media budget across campaign-based and always-on programs, maximizing efficiency and business impact.
Define analytics and measurement frameworks that provide clear attribution, actionable insights, and a comprehensive view of marketing performance.
Leverage customer, campaign, and market data to inform strategy, improve targeting, and deepen customer engagement.
Partner with Marketing Technology, Data, and IT teams to develop an integrated marketing technology architecture aligned with Vanguard's global design standards and future-state vision.
Evaluate emerging digital marketing and marketing technology solutions, including customer data platforms, artificial intelligence, and machine learning capabilities, to continuously enhance Vanguard's digital marketing effectiveness.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of digital marketing professionals while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture.
Manage agency and vendor partnerships to ensure strong performance, accountability, innovation, and alignment with business goals.

Education & Experience:

10+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, including significant digital marketing leadership experience within financial services, asset management, wealth management, banking, insurance, or a related financial institution.
Demonstrated success developing and executing large-scale digital marketing strategies that drive measurable business outcomes, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.
Deep expertise across digital marketing disciplines, including paid media, digital acquisition, customer journey optimization, marketing automation, personalization, analytics, and marketing technology.
Strong understanding of advisor and investor audiences, financial products, and the regulatory environment governing financial services marketing.
Proven experience managing substantial digital marketing budgets and external agency/vendor relationships.
Experience operating in complex, global, matrixed organizations and influencing senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
Undergraduate degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
Proficiency in English required; French language skills are an asset.

Key Candidate Profile:

Recognized digital marketing leader with a track record of transforming digital capabilities and driving growth within the financial services industry.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical, commercial, and execution skills.
Passion for leveraging data, technology, and innovation to enhance the customer experience and business outcomes.
Effective people leader with experience building and developing high-performing teams.

jobs.title: VP, Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Planitar, we build technology that helps people see and understand the world’s spaces more clearly.

We are the creators of iGUIDE, a powerful property technology solution that combines immersive 3D tours, accurate floor plans and reliable spatial data into a single, easy-to-use system. Our cameras and software platform are used by professionals in real estate, insurance, construction and property management to simplify their work and deliver better results.

Planitar recently joined REA Group, one of the world’s leading digital property companies. REA operates Australia’s largest residential and commercial property platforms, including realestate.com.au and has a growing global footprint across Asia and North America. Together, we are shaping the future of property technology, combining Planitar’s deep spatial data expertise with REA’s global scale and innovation engine.

OUR VISION

A connected future where reliable spatial data enables informed decisions across the property lifecycle.

OUR VALUES

Integrity:
We do the right thing even when it’s hard.
Teamwork:
We are one team, on a big mission.
Innovation:
We value creative solutions for emerging opportunities.
Accountability:
We honour our commitments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Planitar is looking for a VP, Finance to lead our finance function through a period of continued growth. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has operated inside a company with $100M+ in revenue, but who thrives in the scaling-company environment ($50M–$100M).

The ideal candidate is someone comfortable building process and infrastructure rather than simply administering what's already in place. You'll lead a team of 5-8, including a Sr. Manager, Finance and 4-5 Financial Analysts/Billing Specialists, and will be a key partner to the CEO and executive team on financial strategy, M&A, and IFRS based accounting.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the finance function end-to-end: financial planning & analysis, accounting operations, billing, treasury, and financial reporting.
Lead and develop a team of 5-8, including direct management of a Sr. Manager, Finance and oversight of 4-5 Financial Analysts/Billing Specialists.
Drive M&A activity, including deal evaluation, due diligence, structuring support, and post-acquisition financial integration across international entities.
Design and implement scalable financial processes and controls appropriate for a company moving towards its next growth stage — replacing manual processes with repeatable, integrated systems.
Lead or support ERP/financial systems implementations (NetSuite experience strongly preferred), improving automation, reporting accuracy, and close efficiency.
Partner with the CEO and executive team on financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and both parent and board-level reporting.
Oversee cash flow management, banking relationships, and treasury operations across multiple currencies/jurisdictions as applicable.
Ensure compliance with tax, statutory, and regulatory requirements across all operating geographies.
Build out and mature FP&A capabilities to support data-driven decision-making across the business.
Act as a key advisor to the CEO on capital structure, financing strategy, and long-term financial planning.

QUALIFICATIONS

10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including prior experience at the VP level.
Direct experience with global M&A; deal evaluation, due diligence, integration, and managing finance across multiple international entities/jurisdictions.
A track record of designing and implementing financial processes and controls, ideally having taken a finance function through a period of scaling.
Experience operating inside a company with $100M+ in revenue, combined with genuine comfort operating in a leaner, faster-moving organization in the $50M range — this is not a "run what already exists" role.
Proven people leadership experience managing teams of 5+ across finance/accounting functions.
NetSuite implementation or optimization experience strongly preferred; broader ERP design & implementation experience considered.
CPA (or equivalent) designation preferred.
Strong communication skills and comfort operating as a direct financial advisor to the CEO/executive team.
Experience in a technology, SaaS, or hardware-adjacent business is an asset given Planitar's product line.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR

Financial processes and controls are meaningfully more scalable and automated than when you started.
The finance team is well-managed, with clear roles, development plans, and reporting cadence.
Any active or upcoming M&A activity is well-supported from a financial diligence and integration standpoint.
Leadership has clearer, faster, and more reliable financial visibility into the business.
Key financial, tax and operational risks are clearly identified, and regularly reported to leadership.
The broader organization understands why a timely, accurate close matters, how their own inputs affect it, and how reliable financial information helps drive key business decisions.
IFRS transition complete with a clean audit opinion and an approved accounting policy manual which is applied across all entities.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

100% employer-paid flexible benefits plan

Comprehensive Health & Dental coverage
Health Spending Account (HSA) or Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) options
DPSP match
Hybrid Work Environment
Professional Development Incentive
Opportunities to grow as we scale
The backing of a global industry leader through REA Group

ACCESSIBILITY, INCLUSION & AI DISCLOSURE

Planitar is committed to a diverse, equitable, inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. This is a back fill position. We provide accommodation under AODA at any hiring stage upon request.

In line with Ontario law, we use AI only to summarize interview notes, never to screen, assess, or decide on candidates — all decisions are made by our team. Please note this is a new position.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
BE AT THE FOREFRONT OF CANADA’S CLEAN ENERGY TRANSFORMATION.

Salient Energy Inc. is advancing the next generation of safe, sustainable energy storage technology. Our zinc-ion batteries are designed to accelerate the global shift toward renewable power, providing a safer, more cost-effective, and scalable alternative to lithium-ion.  

We’re looking for a results-driven, technically savvy Chief Technology Officer who understands the pace, complexity, and challenges of a startup environment and brings a genuine passion for clean tech energy. As we move into the heart of commercialization, this leader will drive the continued advancement of our zinc-ion battery platform, aligning technology, execution, and team leadership to support scale, market readiness, and commercial success.  

THE ROLE

Reporting to the CEO, the Chief Technology Officer will provide strategic and hands-on leadership across Salient Energy’s technology function at a critical stage in the company’s growth, balancing deep technical expertise with the operational and commercial oversight needed to advance through commercialization.   

Leading the R&D, Cell Development, and Quality teams, the CTO will align technical direction, cross-functional execution, and team capability to support scale, certification, market readiness, and accelerated commercial success. As a member of the executive team, this leader will foster a strong, accountable, and collaborative culture while also serving as a trusted technical voice with the Board, investors, and external partners.  

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lead Salient’s technology function by providing strategic and technical leadership across R&D, Cell Development, and Quality.  
Define and deliver product specifications, technical priorities, and performance metrics aligned with Salient’s technology roadmap and TRL targets.  
Support the successful advancement of Salient’s battery platform through commercialization, including readiness for scale, certification, and market adoption  
Ensure required product and process certifications, including UL and CSA standards, are achieved.  
Represent Salient externally as a credible technical leader with the Board, investors, partners, and at relevant industry and technical forums.  

YOUR SKILLS, EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Education & Technical Depth

PhD in Chemistry, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or Materials Science/Engineering.  
Deep expertise in battery chemistry, electrochemistry, and testing processes, supported by 10+ years in a chemistry lab environment.  
Experience with advanced battery materials and ion transport mechanisms is considered an asset.  

Product Development & Commercialization

8–10 years leading development projects, with demonstrated experience bringing new products to market.  
Proven ability to align technical priorities with commercialization milestones, performance goals, and market needs.  

Leadership Profile

Strategic & Commercial Acumen – able to connect technical direction to commercialization, scale, and business goals.  
Technical & Operational Leadership – brings rigor, focus, and accountability across complex technical programs.  
People & Stakeholder Influence – builds strong teams and communicates credibly with employees, executives, investors, and partners.  

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate brings the technical depth and scientific credibility expected of a CTO, along with the leadership, operational oversight, and commercial mindset needed to advance Salient’s technology through commercialization. While technical capability is essential, success in this role will depend on the ability to translate innovation into practical commercial application, aligning technical priorities with business objectives, supporting teams with clarity and accountability, and sustaining momentum toward scale, market readiness, and performance. This leader will understand how to balance thoughtful refinement and continuous innovation with the urgency required to meet business goals and move the product forward.  

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to mentor teams and translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.  

WHY SALIENT?

At Salient, you’ll work alongside a team of scientists, engineers, and innovators who are deeply committed to building a safer, cleaner energy future. We believe the best ideas come from curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. As CTO, you will play a defining leadership role in shaping our technology strategy, strengthening our technical organization, and advancing our products toward market adoption. Your work will directly influence how Salient scales its zinc-ion platform and delivers meaningful impact in one of the world’s most important sectors: clean energy storage.  

We offer a competitive salary and a collegiate, supportive, and diverse team environment. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to lead meaningful innovation, develop exceptional teams, and help build a technology company positioned to make a real difference.  

TO APPLY

If you’re ready to lead the advancement of future-defining battery technology, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a compelling cover letter outlining your fit for this role for an initial review.  

We embrace inclusion and diversity and welcome applicants to self-identify. Please feel free to indicate if you belong or self-identify. Please note this is an on-site position and requires the successful candidate to be able to commute to our location in HRM; preference will be given to local candidates. All applications will be reviewed, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director of Sales Strategy and Solution Design
jobs.description:
*Current or previous experience in the Staffing & Recruitment industry is required for this position*

About the role

The Director will support the Vice President Sales as a trusted advisor. As a strategic thinker this individual brings operational experience executing on key sales focus areas. The Director is a strategic and critical role responsible for working closely with business development and account expansion leaders to drive key strategic initiatives and delivering profitable solution design. The director leads the analysis and architecture of client solutions by assessing the client’s requirements, developing and validating solution design.

What you’ll be doing

Oversees solution design and provides support for business development and account expansion opportunities.
Assesses client business needs, goals and overall strategic direction.
Leads the analysis and architecture of client solutions.
Develops and validates solution design/blueprint.
Collaborates with internal business partners to develop profitable account design recommendations.
Stays abreast of industry/market knowledge and trends.
Improves the probability of RFP wins for strategic deals by incorporating solution design to create opportunity tailored value propositions for every bid.
Collaborate with Vice President, Sales to ensure execution of agreed goals and initiatives.
Ensure proactive management of key relationships both internally and externally (employees, executives, clients, industry organizations, etc).
Identify pain points throughout the sales organization and optimize processes and procedures to improve efficiencies across teams.
Represent company as required, including at industry events and conferences.
Support the Vice President, Sales in preparation for corporate meetings, and meetings with key external stakeholders, including customers, and strategic partners
Partner with the Vice President, Sales to develop and drive key strategic initiatives that support the long-term growth and success of the business.
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration ensuring successful execution of key projects and initiatives.
Provide expert analysis, insights, and recommendations on a wide range of business topics, including market trends, competitive threats, and emerging opportunities.
Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and other materials to support the Vice President, Sales in decision-making and problem-solving.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

About you

Completion of post-secondary education in related field or years of equivalent experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
A minimum of eight (8) years of related experience, preferably within the service sector.
A minimum of three (3) years in a management or leadership role.
Proficient in Microsoft Office products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and Outlook.
Bilingualism (English & French) is an asset.

BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES:
Strong leadership skills. Can effectively develop and articulate both short-term and long-term business strategies, influencing and motivating others towards such goals.
Strategic orientation with a solid understanding of how the strategies help drive the bottom line.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, both one-on-one and in group settings.
Able to gather, consolidate and evaluate information, identify key issues, draw conclusions and devise solutions based on sound, practical judgment, experience and operational knowledge.
Demonstrated business professionalism, respect for confidentiality and experience handling sensitive information.
Superior organizational skills. Can effectively manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines consistently while maintaining high levels of attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to work across all levels of the organization to obtain resources and provide support and expertise.
Strong planning, research, and project management skills. Proactive and able to solve problems effectively and rapidly using excellent analytical skills.
Proven consistently high levels of customer service performance.
Flexible and adaptable to changing business needs, with an ability to travel when required.

Why choose us?

It’s an exciting time to be part of our team. We’re proud to be a global thought-leader and care about doing the best job we can to ensure better futures for everyone. We do this by building our Future@Work strategy as a united team of 30,000+ colleagues with a collective spirit working in over 60 countries globally.

You’ll have the opportunity to grow across a variety of interesting jobs and careers over our extensive portfolio of global brands. new_jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Chief Technology & Strategy Officer (CTSO) participates in the development and execution of corporate strategy as part of Cascadia Credit Union’s (CCU) executive team in accordance with policies, goals, and objectives established by the CEO and the Board of Directors. Overseeing and Leading CCU's corporate planning, strategic initiatives, and technology functions, the CTSO works collaboratively across the organization to identify opportunities for growth, operational excellence, organizational effectiveness, and enhanced member value.

This position provides direction, communication, and leadership in strategic planning, organizational transformation, and enterprise-wide initiatives, ensuring organizational priorities are translated into measurable outcomes and supporting the overall and long-term business strategy of CCU. The CTSO facilitates the corporate planning process, guides the delivery of key strategic initiatives, and promotes innovation that strengthens CCU's sustainability and competitive position.

This position role model’s leadership, promoting and living CCU values, and fostering a culture where members are at the centre of our decision making, employees are knowledgeable, and CCU is recognized as a committed community partner.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

·        Fosters relationships through service excellence and knowledge to support staff and provide leadership in the development and execution of corporate strategy and organization priorities.
·        Collaborates with executive leadership to develop corporate strategies and policies; identifies and meets short and long-term objectives and areas of information systems and technology.
·        Leads the development, facilitation, and monitoring of CCU's corporate strategic planning process and associated business plans.
·        Oversees the successful delivery of enterprise-wide strategic initiatives and transformational projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
·        Develops frameworks and reporting mechanisms to measure progress against strategic objectives and key performance indicators.
·        Identifies emerging trends, opportunities, and risks that may impact CCU's long-term success and recommends strategic responses.
·        Promotes innovation, continuous improvement, and organizational effectiveness across the credit union.
·        Directs and leads the credit union's information systems, programming, cyber-security, and IT operations functions and seeks innovative strategies to ensure optimum integration of the enterprise technology framework.
·        Utilizes data and promote the use of data to support organization effectiveness and the delivery of proactive needs-based advice.
·        Manages key relationships to ensure compliance with any legislation, regulation, and/or suitable guidelines based on the size and complexity of the credit union.
·        Provides overall management and direction of information technology and related policies, procedures, and objectives.
·        Implements functional risk management tools and mechanisms to effectively secure and safe - guard the credit union’s IT infrastructure.                              
·        Supports employees' development through a demonstrated commitment to coaching and other development activities.
·        Builds and leads a high performing team to execute on strategies and to meet current needs and future demands.
·        Promotes CCU in the community through active participation in community events and professional associations.

Skills & Attributes

·        Demonstrates strong strategic thinking skills and the ability to translate vision into measurable organizational outcomes.
·        Demonstrated ability to lead strategic planning, organizational transformation, and enterprise-wide initiatives.
·        Demonstrated commitment to applying relevant and applicable policies and procedures in the day-to-day performance of the functions of this position.
·        Committed to personal growth and development; responsible for ensuring skills and knowledge are up to date to meet industry and position requirements.
·        Takes a proactive and respectful approach in addressing problems, issues, or conflict with a positive view to reaching new and better solutions.
·        Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and thoughtful, clear, and open communication.
·        Team player, driven to ensure that the whole team is successful in meeting organizational needs.
·        Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
·        Demonstrates strong attention to detail and accuracy in completing work and providing information.
·        Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
·        Exceptional time management & organizational skills.

Qualifications

·        Minimum four (4) years post-secondary education; diploma or degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Leadership, Strategy, Finance, Economics, or a related field preferred.
·        Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in management or leadership role.
·        Combined experience and post-secondary education in the areas that directly relate to the financial industry and IT will be considered.
·        Demonstrates relevant knowledge and understanding of the external credit union environment.
·        Demonstrate an exceptional understanding of information systems and technology.

new_jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
new_jobs.description:
BE AT THE FOREFRONT OF CANADA’S CLEAN ENERGY TRANSFORMATION.

Salient Energy Inc. is advancing the next generation of safe, sustainable energy storage technology. Our zinc-ion batteries are designed to accelerate the global shift toward renewable power, providing a safer, more cost-effective, and scalable alternative to lithium-ion.  

We’re looking for a results-driven, technically savvy Chief Technology Officer who understands the pace, complexity, and challenges of a startup environment and brings a genuine passion for clean tech energy. As we move into the heart of commercialization, this leader will drive the continued advancement of our zinc-ion battery platform, aligning technology, execution, and team leadership to support scale, market readiness, and commercial success.  

THE ROLE

Reporting to the CEO, the Chief Technology Officer will provide strategic and hands-on leadership across Salient Energy’s technology function at a critical stage in the company’s growth, balancing deep technical expertise with the operational and commercial oversight needed to advance through commercialization.   

Leading the R&D, Cell Development, and Quality teams, the CTO will align technical direction, cross-functional execution, and team capability to support scale, certification, market readiness, and accelerated commercial success. As a member of the executive team, this leader will foster a strong, accountable, and collaborative culture while also serving as a trusted technical voice with the Board, investors, and external partners.  

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lead Salient’s technology function by providing strategic and technical leadership across R&D, Cell Development, and Quality.  
Define and deliver product specifications, technical priorities, and performance metrics aligned with Salient’s technology roadmap and TRL targets.  
Support the successful advancement of Salient’s battery platform through commercialization, including readiness for scale, certification, and market adoption  
Ensure required product and process certifications, including UL and CSA standards, are achieved.  
Represent Salient externally as a credible technical leader with the Board, investors, partners, and at relevant industry and technical forums.  

YOUR SKILLS, EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Education & Technical Depth

PhD in Chemistry, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or Materials Science/Engineering.  
Deep expertise in battery chemistry, electrochemistry, and testing processes, supported by 10+ years in a chemistry lab environment.  
Experience with advanced battery materials and ion transport mechanisms is considered an asset.  

Product Development & Commercialization

8–10 years leading development projects, with demonstrated experience bringing new products to market.  
Proven ability to align technical priorities with commercialization milestones, performance goals, and market needs.  

Leadership Profile

Strategic & Commercial Acumen – able to connect technical direction to commercialization, scale, and business goals.  
Technical & Operational Leadership – brings rigor, focus, and accountability across complex technical programs.  
People & Stakeholder Influence – builds strong teams and communicates credibly with employees, executives, investors, and partners.  

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate brings the technical depth and scientific credibility expected of a CTO, along with the leadership, operational oversight, and commercial mindset needed to advance Salient’s technology through commercialization. While technical capability is essential, success in this role will depend on the ability to translate innovation into practical commercial application, aligning technical priorities with business objectives, supporting teams with clarity and accountability, and sustaining momentum toward scale, market readiness, and performance. This leader will understand how to balance thoughtful refinement and continuous innovation with the urgency required to meet business goals and move the product forward.  

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to mentor teams and translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.  

WHY SALIENT?

At Salient, you’ll work alongside a team of scientists, engineers, and innovators who are deeply committed to building a safer, cleaner energy future. We believe the best ideas come from curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. As CTO, you will play a defining leadership role in shaping our technology strategy, strengthening our technical organization, and advancing our products toward market adoption. Your work will directly influence how Salient scales its zinc-ion platform and delivers meaningful impact in one of the world’s most important sectors: clean energy storage.  

We offer a competitive salary and a collegiate, supportive, and diverse team environment. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to lead meaningful innovation, develop exceptional teams, and help build a technology company positioned to make a real difference.  

TO APPLY

If you’re ready to lead the advancement of future-defining battery technology, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a compelling cover letter outlining your fit for this role for an initial review.  

We embrace inclusion and diversity and welcome applicants to self-identify. Please feel free to indicate if you belong or self-identify. Please note this is an on-site position and requires the successful candidate to be able to commute to our location in HRM; preference will be given to local candidates. All applications will be reviewed, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
